description:
Functional specifications covered / files: lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex and existing adapter options/result modules
Use compatible verified provider upload/prepare/send/edit operations; preserve ordinary text, formatting, existing-message selection and provider receipts. No provider-specific planner or bridge requirements resolver. Preserve callback cardinality. Unsupported adapters remain unsupported rather than using fabricated capabilities.

Tests to add before implementation: Actual adapter-boundary integration where available; upload batches; message edits; real provider IDs; partial failures; existing thread identity; ordinary text parity; Telegram absent-metadata behavior.

Branches/paths validated: Actual adapter-boundary integration where available; upload batches; message edits; real provider IDs; partial failures; existing thread identity; ordinary text parity; Telegram absent-metadata behavior.

Action reuse assessment: Extend JidoChatBridge existing transport functions and AdapterOptions/DeliveryResult; adapter owns HTTP/provider details. No new Action and no parallel send path.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.

Approved PR5 behavior (user confirmation, 2026-11-27): Preserve the reference root-publication policy. Under abort, stop publication after failure and retain earlier confirmed results. Under continue, an unconfirmed root send remains unconfirmed; promote the next eligible candidate with the original answer, then thread subsequent messages under the confirmed root. Never retry the failed operation itself. Possible duplicate answer text after an uncertain provider acceptance is an accepted consequence of this policy. This supersedes the audit suggestion to stop dependent publications after an unconfirmed root. Implement with current separate Plan and Outgoing.attachments contracts; do not restore Outgoing.Delivery. Regression acceptance: a timed-out first root is invoked once, the next candidate publishes the original answer once, later messages use the confirmed root ID, and the report preserves the original uncertainty and partial outcome. Reference: ../zaq-feat-channel-files/test/zaq/channels/delivery/executor_test.exs, test "continue retains an unknown send and promotes the next candidate with the original answer". This approval settles this policy only; it does not approve unrelated reference architecture or change existing test expectations wholesale. Action reuse: planning update only; no executable operation changes.

comments.text: Moved to PR5 per Jad seven-PR split. Not part of feat/delivery_plan PR4. Existing functional/test/reuse specification retained. Executor prerequisite and PR5 review/coverage finalization must be planned before implementation.
